hintroom.level9.belfry: The Void Lord rings the last bell. Take cover behind the pillars and dodge!
hintroom.level9.bellguard: The pyromancer keeps his distance and hurls fireballs. Take cover, then strike!
hintroom.level9.counterweight: Push each block onto its plate: every counterweight that drops calls a wave.
hintroom.level9.echoorchard: The red hero reads the runes, the others strike them. Then they hold the centre.
hintroom.level9.forecourt: Pull the far lever, then run to the plate by the door before it drops back.
hintroom.level9.gallery: Timed levers: all active together. The farthest one lasts the longest.
hintroom.level9.nave: Three pit bands cut the nave. Each hero holds a plate to open the door.
hintroom.level9.ropehall: A second wraith leads a swarm of flyers. Stay together and take cover!
level.level9.intro.1: The Void did not fade, it fell silent. The four bells are mute.
level.level9.intro.2: The fragment beats at the very top of the belfry. I can feel the last bell.
level.level9.intro.3: One bell, four hands. You must ring together.
level.level9.intro.4: We climb. Together, up to the last bell.
level.level9.name: The Dawn Belfry
level.level9.outro.1: The last bell rings true. Dawn finally rises over Vaelorn.
level.level9.outro.2: It is over... The ancient shadow is at peace. Each of you lit the road for the others.
level.level9.outro.3: The Crystal shines brighter than ever. Vaelorn will fear neither shadow nor night!
level.level9.outro.4: Shall we go home? This time I carry the lantern... and dessert.
mech.level9.echoorchard.orchardRunes: Rune pedestals (sequence seen by the red hero)
mech.level9.forecourt.forecourtLever: Forecourt lever (drops fast: run to the plate)
objective.level9.bell: Blue hero: open the forecourt door (lever, then plate)
objective.level9.measure: Red hero: hold the measure for 15 s in the echo orchard
objective.level9.sweep: Green hero: land 6 killing blows in the nave
objective.level9.weights: Yellow hero: drop all three counterweights
room.level9.belfry.name: The Belfry
room.level9.bellguard.name: The Bell Warden
room.level9.counterweight.name: The Counterweight Hall
room.level9.echoorchard.name: The Echo Orchard
room.level9.forecourt.name: The Bell Forecourt
room.level9.gallery.name: The Gallery of Clappers
room.level9.nave.name: The Nave of Pits
room.level9.ropehall.name: The Rope Hall
sign.level9.belfry.cover: Pillars stop projectiles. The sealed exit opens when he falls.
sign.level9.belfry.warning: The Void Lord: rings, spirals, danger zones, and his minions. Keep moving!
sign.level9.bellguard.cover: Pillars stop fireballs. The healing crystals are deep in the arena.
sign.level9.bellguard.fire: Beware the nova: it takes a while to charge. Get out of the fire circle!
sign.level9.bellguard.guard: The bell warden: a pyromancer. He keeps his distance, make him come to you!
sign.level9.counterweight.blocks: Three blocks, three plates: push each block east (two heroes, or alone if needed).
sign.level9.counterweight.door: The door opens once all three counterweights drop: the yellow hero's goal.
sign.level9.counterweight.waves: Each covered plate calls a wave. Beat it before pushing the next block.
sign.level9.echoorchard.door: The door needs the runes in order AND the measure held. It stays open afterwards.
sign.level9.echoorchard.measure: The measure: the red hero stands there 15 s in total. The ambush springs on entry.
sign.level9.echoorchard.pedestals: Six pedestals at the edges of the orchard. Strike them in the order the red hero calls.
sign.level9.echoorchard.seer: The red hero reads the rune sequence here, on their screen. The others cannot see it.
sign.level9.forecourt.bells: The Dawn Belfry. Four mute bells: you must wake them, together.
sign.level9.forecourt.lever: This lever drops after 19 s. Pull it, then get someone onto the plate.
sign.level9.forecourt.plate: The plate by the door: stay on it while the lever is active.
sign.level9.gallery.cadence: The cadence: timed levers, from the farthest to the nearest to the door.
sign.level9.gallery.colors: Each hero pulls THEIR coloured lever. The two plain levers: anyone.
sign.level9.gallery.door: The door opens when every lever is active together. A failed relay can be replayed.
sign.level9.gallery.order: The lever farthest from the door lasts the longest: best to start with it.
sign.level9.nave.door: The nave door: plates held, nave cleared, six killing blows landed.
sign.level9.nave.pits: Three pit bands cut the nave. Use the crossings and watch the flanks.
sign.level9.nave.plates: Four coloured plates: each hero holds theirs, at the same time, to open the door.
sign.level9.nave.sweep: The green hero must land 6 killing blows in the nave. Give them a chance!
sign.level9.ropehall.cover: Pillars shelter you from dark bolts. The healing crystals are set back.
sign.level9.ropehall.ropes: The bell ropes hang down. Do not stay in the open against the wisps.
sign.level9.ropehall.wraith: A second flying wraith, escorted by bats and wisps.
